response.justification: Technically the candidate far exceeds the bar: 15+ years of fullstack work, deep TypeScript/Node.js and React experience, AWS, Docker/Kubernetes, and current exposure to AI-agent/LLM tooling — all of which map directly onto the required and nice-to-have skills. The problem is fit rather than capability: this is an entry-level individual contributor role, and a Staff/Senior engineer is likely to be misaligned on compensation, scope, and long-term retention. Secondary gaps are PostgreSQL (his relational depth reads as MySQL/generic SQL, with MongoDB as the dominant datastore), no Nest.js exposure, and only basic German for an on-site role in a German energy-consulting/construction domain. Worth a conversation only if the company is open to shaping the role upward or the candidate has explicitly signalled willingness to step down in scope.
strengths: Deep TypeScript/Node.js + React fullstack experience across many production systems
Strong nice-to-have coverage: AWS, Kubernetes, Docker, LLM/agent tooling
Clear engineering-craft focus (TDD, CI/CD, testable architecture) plus Berlin-based
concerns: Significantly overqualified for an entry-level role — comp and retention risk
PostgreSQL and Nest.js not evidenced; relational depth skews MySQL/MongoDB
Only basic German for an on-site German construction/energy-consulting domain

key_factors.factor: Core stack match (TypeScript, React, Node, REST)
Missing PostgreSQL/Nest.js specifics and limited German
